subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should immediate text acknowledgment become a shared progress-draft lifecycle option, or a separate persistent message contract for channels that cannot safely edit or delete a draft?
rationale: Current main has a strong shared progress implementation, but an unconditional pre-processing send changes message clutter, cleanup, privacy, transport capability, and configuration semantics; repository evidence cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Extend progress lifecycle
options.body: Add configurable immediate-start timing and a generic operator-authored label to shared progress drafts, with capability-aware fallbacks for channels without safe edit support.

options.title: Add persistent ack text
options.body: Introduce a separate scoped acknowledgment-message contract that sends a permanent text reply before every qualifying agent run.

options.title: Keep channel-specific behavior
options.body: Continue using progress drafts, typing indicators, and reactions per transport without promising one cross-channel text acknowledgment contract.

recommendation.title: Extend progress lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add configurable immediate-start timing and a generic operator-authored label to shared progress drafts, with capability-aware fallbacks for channels without safe edit support.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects Vincent to the shared progress-draft and channel message-lifecycle surfaces where this direction would be implemented.
